chapter.title: What Are Design Patterns? Why Use Them?

payload.markdown: Design patterns demonstrate and apply principles of object-oriented design. So, a study of design patterns can yield more than a specific solution in a context. You can come away with a new perspective on the ways that objects and classes can be combined to achieve an objective.

blocks.text: Design patterns demonstrate and apply principles of object-oriented design. So, a study of design patterns can yield more than a specific solution in a context. You can come away with a new perspective on the ways that objects and classes can be combined to achieve an objective.

items: Classes & Objects: A class defines state and behaviour; objects are instances of that definition.
Abstract Classes: A partial base class that forces subclasses to complete certain methods.
Behavioral Patterns: Patterns that distribute responsibility and coordinate behaviour.
Creational Patterns: Patterns that control how objects come into being.
Design Principles: Guidelines such as SOLID that keep object designs flexible.
Enterprise Patterns: Patterns for service layers, domain objects and application architecture.
Error Patterns: Repeatable strategies: fail fast, wrap and rethrow, aggregate and report.
Factory Pattern: Creating objects through a dedicated creator instead of new at every call site.
